title: Keys are flying: three issued overnight, the newsroom is live, and one choice about who can sign as you
headline: 27 agent commits since brief 11. Site keys: yours, Indi's (issued by her conductor at 07:21) and Jose's are on the keys list; Indi still has to add hers. The newsroom agent put web-summit.newsroom.sgit.ai live (v0.1.1, the skeleton); company pages next. The generic QR still waits for your yes in the designer's session, so the print stays at 3 of 7.
